title: Get paid
summary: Connect payments, stand up subscriptions, send the invoice, reconcile the payout.

parts.title: Connect a payment processor
parts.guidance: Choose the payment setup from the business entity, customer locations, currencies and intended payment methods. Follow the processor connection workflow to confirm account approval, authorized access and settlement details. Validate the integration with an appropriate test transaction before accepting live payments, and preserve the settlement identifiers needed to reconcile collections into the books.

parts.title: Set up subscription billing
parts.guidance: Translate the approved commercial offer into subscription products, billing intervals and customer lifecycle rules. Use the billing workflow to test signup, renewal, changes, cancellation and failed-payment handling before authorized release. Keep the tested configuration and product identifiers with the offer so invoices and revenue records can be traced to the terms customers accepted.

parts.title: Send an invoice
parts.guidance: Prepare the customer's invoice from the agreed sale or subscription and its billing data. Check whether the billing system already issues the invoice to avoid duplicate charges or conflicting records. Obtain approval where required, preserve the invoice and delivery result, and pass its payment and settlement references into bookkeeping when funds arrive.

parts.title: Bookkeeping close
parts.guidance: Reconcile customer invoices, processor charges, refunds, fees and payouts for the reporting period. Use the close workflow to explain differences between billed revenue, collected amounts and cash deposited in the bank. Retain the reconciliations and unresolved exceptions so a successful payment event is not mistaken for a fully settled and accounted-for transaction.
